L108: Artist(s) with most wins  | 【37†Ive】 (7)
L109: Song with highest score  | "【38†Tomboy】" by 【39†(G)I-dle】 (9,648)
L110: 【40†Image: Four women dressed in black outfits. The third woman from the left is holding a small trophy†thumb.wikimedia.org】【39†(G)I-dle】's win for 【38†"Tomboy"】 had the highest score of 2022, with 9,648 points on the April 3 broadcast. "Tomboy" and their succeeding single "【41†Nxde】" both earned triple crowns.
L111: The 【42†Inkigayo】 Chart is a 【43†music program】 【44†record chart】 on 【45†Seoul Broadcasting System】 (SBS) that gives an award to the best-performing 【46†single】 of the week in South Korea.
L112: In 2022, the chart awarded points based on digital performance in domestic online music services (5,500 points), social media via 【47†YouTube】 views (3,000 points), album sales (1,000 points), network on-air time (1,000 points), viewer votes in advance of the show (500 points), and real-time voting via the Starpass 【48†mobile app】 (500 points) in its ranking methodology.^{【49†[1]】}^{【50†[2]】}^{【51†[3]】} Songs that spend three weeks at number one are awarded a 【52†triple crown】 and are removed from the chart and ineligible to win again.
L113: 【53†Treasure】's 【54†Jihoon】, 【55†Riize】's 【56†Sungchan】, and 【37†Ive】's 【57†An Yu-jin】 had been hosting the show since March 7, 2021 and continued to do so till March 27, 2022. Starting in April 2022, actress 【58†Roh Jeong-eui】, actor 【59†Seo Bum-june】, and 【60†Tomorrow X Together】 member 【61†Choi Yeon-jun】 became the new hosts of the show.
L114: In 2022, 20 singles achieved number one on the chart, and 15 acts were awarded first-place trophies for this feat.
L115: Eleven songs collected trophies for three weeks and earned a triple crown: Ive's "【62†Eleven】"^{【63†[4]】} and "【64†Love Dive】",^{【65†[5]】} 【66†Taeyeon】's "【67†INVU】",^{【68†[6]】} 【69†Big Bang】's "【70†Still Life】",^{【71†[7]】} 【72†Psy】's "【73†That That】",^{【74†[8]】} 【39†(G)I-dle】's "【38†Tomboy】"^{【75†[9]】} and "【41†Nxde】",^{【76†[10]】} 【77†Nayeon】's "【78†Pop!】",^{【79†[11]】} 【80†Blackpink】's "【81†Pink Venom】"^{【82†[12]】} and "【83†Shut Down】",^{【84†[13]】} and 【85†Younha】's "Event Horizon".^{【86†[14]】} The number-one song at the start of the year was Ive's debut single "Eleven".^{【87†[15]】} The group had two more singles rank number one in 2022: "Love Dive" and "【88†After Like】".
L116: The three songs spent a total of seven weeks atop the chart making Ive the artist with the most weeks at number one in 2022.
L117: 【89†Got the Beat】, a 【90†supergroup】 consisting of 【91†BoA】, Taeyeon and 【92†Hyoyeon】 from 【93†Girls' Generation】, 【94†Seulgi】 and 【95†Wendy】 from 【96†Red Velvet】, and 【97†Karina】 and 【98†Winter】 from 【99†Aespa】, achieved their first number one with their debut single "【100†Step Back】" on the January 30 broadcast.^{【101†[16]】}^{【102†[17]】} Member Taeyeon had one number-one single on the chart in 2022, "INVU", which also achieved a triple crown.
L118: Girl group 【103†NewJeans】 made their first appearance on the chart with their debut single "【104†Attention】".^{【105†[18]】} 【106†Twice】's Nayeon achieved her first-ever Inkigayo award with her debut single "Pop!".^{【107†[19]】}
L119: Besides Ive, three other acts had more than one number one on the chart in 2022. (G)I-dle had two singles rank number one in 2022, "Tomboy" and "Nxde", both of which ranked number one for three weeks and achieved triple crowns. Their single "Tomboy" acquired 9,648 points on the April 3 broadcast, making it the song with the highest score of the year. Blackpink also had two number-one singles, "Pink Venom" and "Shut Down", both of which achieved triple crowns.
L120: The only other artist to have two number-one singles in 2022 was 【108†NCT Dream】, who achieved this with their singles "【109†Glitch Mode】" and "【110†Beatbox】".

L125: 【37†Ive】 won their first Inkigayo trophy and their first triple crown for "【62†Eleven】". They also earned a triple crown for the succeeding single "【64†Love Dive】". The two singles along with "【88†After Like】", ranked number one for a total of 7 weeks making them the artist with the most weeks at number-one in 2022. Member 【57†Yujin】 (third from right) was a co-host of the program until March 2022.
L126: 【89†Got the Beat】 earned their first-ever music show win with their Inkigayo trophy for "【100†Step Back】". Member 【66†Taeyeon】 (second from top left) also received a triple crown for "【67†INVU】".
L127: 【106†Twice】's 【77†Nayeon】 received her first-ever music show trophy as a soloist on Inkigayo with "【78†Pop!】". The single went on to achieve a triple crown. 【103†NewJeans】 received their first Inkigayo award for "【104†Attention】". 【112†Image: Four female performers on stage, dressed in light-colored, ornate outfits. They are standing close together, smiling and posing with arms around each other or raised in celebration. They are wearing headset microphones.
L128: The stage is lit with a blue hue and background lights.†thumb.wikimedia.org】【80†Blackpink】 earned two triple crowns with "【81†Pink Venom】" and "【83†Shut Down】". Key
